character.name: Viggrim

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.description: Whispers to the soil; coaxes dormant seeds to sprout or withers one weed instantly.

spells.name: Poison Spray
spells.description: Exhales a cloud of corrosive spores that blister flesh and sour the air.

spells.name: Animal Friendship
spells.description: Weaves a thread of mutual trust across species, calming predators and beasts alike.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.description: Rouses twisted rootlets from the loam to snare ankles and halt marching boots.

character.gear: Antler-Headed Quarterstaff · Treated Boar Hide Vestment · Salt-Cured Hardbread · Stitchwort Salve · Cairn-Warden Sigil · Braided Hemp Rope
character.story: Breeding war-boars for frostbound chieftains, he learned patience and blood-ties. When the Silent Kings succumbed to the pale blight, he swore wardenship over their sunken crypt. Three decades later, he patrols moss-choked vaults that have held nothing but dust since the first winter. Yet he stands firm. An oath carved in bone does not fade because the gold was stolen. He waits for echoes, tending the empty stone with stubborn grace.

inventory.name: Antler-Headed Quarterstaff
inventory.lore: Hewn from a storm-felled oak by his grandsire, who used it to break siege lines before the realm fractured.
inventory.description: A sturdy walking stick crowned with polished reindeer antlers.

inventory.name: Treated Boar Hide Vestment
inventory.lore: Tanned in peat bogs and stitched with sinew, it repels rain and carries the faint musk of his bonded herd.
inventory.description: Heavy leather armor crafted from domesticated war-boar hides.

inventory.name: Salt-Cured Hardbread
inventory.lore: Baked in clay ovens near the Cinder Marches, it sustains weary travelers through blizzard passes without spoiling.
inventory.description: Brick-dry loaves wrapped in oilcloth, rich in preserved salt and grain.

inventory.name: Stitchwort Salve
inventory.lore: Distilled from glowing fungi found beneath the Weeping Spires, it knits torn flesh but leaves scars that shimmer like mica.
inventory.description: A thick amber paste applied to wounds to accelerate cellular regeneration.

inventory.name: Cairn-Warden Sigil
inventory.lore: Carved from a single shard of obsidian by the first tomb guardians, it hums when buried wards are breached, though his vigil now guards only ghosts.
inventory.description: A smooth black stone etched with spiral runes, worn on a braided cord.
inventory.effects: Channels earth-spirit whispers and detects subtle ground tremors

inventory.name: Braided Hemp Rope
inventory.lore: Spun by river-wives along the Serpent Coast, it holds fast against rot and sharp teeth, trusted by smugglers and grave-robbers alike.
inventory.description: Thirty feet of waxed cordage, neatly coiled in a leather satchel.
